CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_task_answer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_test_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_test_variant_id uuid NOT NULL,
    is_correct boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Migration 007 replaces this legacy one-row-per-question constraint with
-- structured selection indexes. Do not restore it when migrations are
-- replayed against an already upgraded database.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task_test_answer_variant'
          AND column_name = 'submitted_order'
    ) THEN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_unique_idx
            ON task_test_answer_variant(student_task_answer_id, task_test_id);
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_task_idx
    ON task_test_answer_variant(task_id);
